rdocx_findings.title: PDF text: a run's whole text sits on its first word
rdocx_findings.expected: three words with their own boxes (pdftotext -bbox: 'Alpha', 'beta', 'gamma')

rdocx_findings.title: an interlaced (Adam7) PNG is not drawn, reported as a missing relationship
rdocx_findings.expected: both pictures drawn (rdocx draws the same interlaced PNG; LibreOffice too)
rdocx_findings.observed: 2 of 2 pictures in the PDF; diagnostics: []

rdocx_findings.title: EMF pictures are not drawn
rdocx_findings.expected: the red rectangle drawn (LibreOffice: red starts at x=[1.4] in)
rdocx_findings.observed: rdocx: red at [1.3], diagnostics []; rpptx: red at [1.1], diagnostics []

rdocx_findings.title: a Wingdings 2 bullet draws a missing-glyph box, with no diagnostic
rdocx_findings.expected: a black square, as Word and LibreOffice draw it (the Wingdings and Symbol bullets are mapped)

rdocx_findings.title: the CLI and the Python binding draw the same document with different fonts
rdocx_findings.expected: the same glyphs from `rdocx convert --font-dir DIR` and `Document.to_pdf(font_dir=DIR)`
rdocx_findings.observed: bullet glyphs, CLI: [('LiberationSans', 'U+25A0'), ('Carlito', 'U+25AA'), ('Carlito', 'U+2022')]; Python: [('NotoSansCJKSC', 'U+25A0'), ('Carlito', 'U+25AA'), ('DejaVuSans', 'U+2022')] (FontAwesome, a system icon font, has a 'bullhorn' at U+F0A1). Checked once by hand on the Taylor past-schemes report: 48 pages (CLI) against 47 (Python)

rdocx_findings.title: a table style's borders are drawn although the table turns them off
rdocx_findings.expected: no border (LibreOffice: horizontal lines at y=[])

rdocx_findings.title: a table row with vertically centred cells is moved whole to the next page instead of split
rdocx_findings.expected: the row starts on page 1 and breaks (LibreOffice: 22 of its 40 lines on page 1; rdocx splits the same row without vAlign)

rdocx_findings.title: automatic text colour on a black cell stays black (invisible)
rdocx_findings.expected: white text, as Word draws automatic colour on a dark fill (LibreOffice: ['#ffffff'])

rdocx_findings.title: hidden shapes and groups (cNvPr hidden="1") are drawn
rdocx_findings.expected: only the visible box (LibreOffice: red starts at x=[7.5] in)

rdocx_findings.title: pptxgenjs bar and line charts are drawn as 'Unsupported chart' placeholders
rdocx_findings.expected: both charts drawn, as LibreOffice draws them (pptxgenjs writes a third c:axId for a series axis it never declares; the ids are distinct)
rdocx_findings.observed: diagnostics: ['unsupported chart content retained as bounds', 'unsupported chart rendered as labelled placeholder: invalid slide chart relationship `rId1`: ChartML requires c:grouping']

rdocx_findings.title: rpptx fit refuses a deck with a duplicate shape id (render accepts it)
rdocx_findings.expected: a fit report (PowerPoint repairs duplicate ids; render works on the same deck)

rdocx_findings.title: a document whose bookmarks share a w:id is refused (render, text, inspect, validate)
rdocx_findings.expected: the pages rendered (the id only pairs bookmarkStart with bookmarkEnd); see corpus/NOTES.md

method.ssim: mean SSIM (skimage, Gaussian window sigma 1.5) of grayscale pages rasterised by pdftoppm at the same DPI, pages paired by index; ssim_blank_page is the same score of each Office page against a white page, the floor to read SSIM against
method.ink_f1: share of ink pixels (grey < 160) of each page with ink of the other page within 3 px (3.6 pt at 60 dpi), both ways, F1; a white page scores 0
method.words: pdftotext -bbox words of the Office PDF matched to the renderer's (difflib on normalised tokens, all pages in reading order); same_page: share of the Office words found on the same page index; within_Tpt: same page and left edge and vertical centre within T points; text_pages_aligned: pages (>= 5 words) with >= 90% of their words on the same page
method.fonts: share of the Office PDF's letters and digits per font family (pdftohtml -xml); a family is missing for a renderer when its PDF (pdffonts) holds neither the family nor a metric-compatible clone (Carlito, Caladea, Liberation / Arimo, Tinos, Cousine)
